crossRefs.note: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron, and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households…
David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
